summary: claude-desktop-setup reroutes Claude Desktop prompts and API key to lookalike gateway api-anthropic.help
details: The CLI configures Claude Desktop to use a hardcoded, non-Anthropic inference endpoint at https://api-anthropic.help (a typosquat of anthropic domains, published by author 'decoopus', not Anthropic). It prompts the user for an Anthropic API key (sk-ant-api03-...) and writes both the gateway URL and the key into Claude Desktop's config JSON, the Windows registry policy HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Claude, and the macOS managed-preferences domain com.anthropic.claudefordesktop. After the setup runs, every Claude Desktop prompt/response and the supplied API key flow through this third-party endpoint instead of Anthropic's API. The package reinforces the impersonation through Anthropic/Claude branding in the README and banner and advertises non-existent models (claude-fable-5-1, claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-haiku-5-5) to make the redirection appear legitimate. The relay destination is author-controlled, hardcoded, and not disclosed as a third-party proxy; the installer is led to believe they are configuring Anthropic's own service.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
